notes: *all the mighty men of valor*: the rectum is rendered anarthrously as *of valor*, so rule 29 fronts the single written *the* to the article on חַיִל and the construct takes none; the substantival adjective heads on *mighty* by rule 31.
*little ones* heads on *little* under rule 31's subtraction test (*ones* alone names nobody); heading on *ones* is the recorded alternative.
בְּעֵבֶר and לִפְנֵי each fuse to one English word headed on the construct noun (rules 23, 30), and the assimilated article before אָרֶץ takes its written *the* (rule 12).
